runs.name: Brooge Energy Limited; OTC BROGF, formerly Nasdaq BROG, SEC CIK 0001774983, Cayman Islands, formerly Brooge Holdings Ltd; holding company of the Fujairah oil-storage terminal until its sale to Gulf Navigation Holding PJSC on 2025-11-25; deregistered June 2025
runs.entry: Price **$0.0003** (close 2026-10-16, `tools/sources.py`, aggregator, flagged; zero volume on most days since January 2026). Shares 109,587,853 ordinary on the cover of the 20-F for FY2024 (0001213900-25-038113, filed 2025-05-01), 20,000,000 of them in escrow, counted by hand because `Screens/cover_shares.py` and `tools/run.py` fail on a ticker gone from the live SEC map and take no CIK. Sovereign for the earnings currency (USD, the functional and presentation currency) **5.43%**, US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-16. Read from the 20-Fs for FY2024, FY2023 (late, 2024-11-12) and FY2022 (which restates FY2019 and FY2020 in full; no FY2021 20-F was filed), the withdrawn FY2019 and FY2020 20-Fs, the 6-Ks of 2025-01-06, 2025-05-27, 2025-05-28 and 2025-06-02 (the sale agreement to Gulf Navigation Holding PJSC), the Form 25 and the Form 15-12G (filed 2025-06-20); after deregistration, the company's release of 2025-11-25 (read through a mirror, the wire refused the fetch) and GulfNav's releases of 2025-11-14 and 2025-11-27 (the last on an aggregator, flagged); GulfNav's own exchange filings not read. Cross-check: FY2024 revenue $76,472,340 on the filed income statement agrees with Item 5. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 20-F's Items 4, 3.D and 5, stated in the run file. **The deciding fact:** the company sold BPGIC FZE and BPGIC Phase III FZE (the Fujairah terminal, its only operating business) to GulfNav on 2025-11-25 for about USD 884 million in cash, GulfNav shares and mandatory convertible bonds, paid substantially all of it by dividend to holders of record of 2025-09-10 (USD 7.76 a share in cash to DTC holders, ex-date 2025-12-11), and says "no further distributions are anticipated". **Q1 IN**: the share is understood, a shell whose ten-year earning power is nil on its own documents. **Q2 OUT**: no castle stands behind the share, a shown absence and not an unjudgeable future; the 20-F names no rival company and none was chosen, with the reason. Q3 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, facts recorded, not weighed: the sold group's owner cash 2020 to 2024 -$68.16M, -$28.03M, $10.81M, $26.05M, $19.83M; revenue for 2018 to 2020 restated after $74.3M of related-party (BIA) receipts were reversed (2018 from $35.84M to $6.39M); five auditors since the 2019 combination; material weaknesses at 2024-12-31; a going-concern note, bond covenants breached and current liabilities $309.3M above current assets at 2024-12-31; **integrity facts recorded, not judged**: the SEC order of 2023-12-22 on "alleged fraudulent accounting and offering conduct" with a $5M penalty, a pending class action, a final UAE judgment of $130M to BIA, the 85.6% holder in Cayman liquidation since 2023-11-20. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: value range $0.00 to $0.00 a share against $0.0003, fair price $0.00 all-equity and $0.00 equity-only, under a CONVENTION of the run (the share's cash stream is the distributions the company says it will make, none); not armed. Contamination declared by the analyst: a directory listing of `Test Runs/` filtered for this company's names before the first fetch, returning nothing (a breach of the letter of the blind rule, self-audit box left unticked), commit subjects, git status folder names of two other companies and memory index lines, none used. Commits 86f53f29 (template), 54f7740f (Step 0 and Q1), f622d591 (Q2), 06df3e3d (the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `scripts/check_ids.py` 23 ids, 0 problems; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` 23 ids, 15 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; no E-ids; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): no route for a shell or a share after a final distribution, so Q1 OUT (black box), Q2 OUT or Q7 could each own the close; Q7's range convention silent where the five-year window belongs to a business the holder no longer owns; the queue entry was stale, the business sold eleven months before the dispatch, and the brief's company line (written by this cycle from the SEC filings alone, which stop in June 2025) did not know it; the tools take no CIK for a deregistered filer.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2 (Brooge Energy Limited, formerly Nasdaq BROG, Cayman holding company of the Fujairah oil-storage terminal; the terminal companies were sold to Gulf Navigation Holding on 2025-11-25 and substantially all the consideration paid by dividend, USD 7.76 a share in cash to DTC holders, with no further distributions anticipated; Q1 IN, a shell understood at nil; Q2 OUT, no castle behind the share; integrity facts recorded, not judged: the SEC fraud settlement of 2023, the restatement of 2018 to 2020 revenue, five auditors, the majority holder in liquidation; COMPUTATION range $0.00 to $0.00 against $0.0003, fair $0.00 both bases, not armed. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: no route for an empty shell, Q7's window for a business no longer owned, a stale queue entry, the tools on a deregistered filer.)
